recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key studio portrait of a female subject in a crouching pose against a stark white void, featuring ultra-thin wide-kerning typography at the top and vertically stacked stylized characters on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically but slightly left-weighted to balance right-side text
Contrast between the organic curves of the subject and the rigid geometric lines of the top text
Color coordination between the subject's attire and the glow/shadow effects on the secondary text
coreInvariants: Pure white background with no horizon line
Subject in a full-body crouch or squatting position
High-contrast lighting with soft shadows on the subject's skin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical height, positioned slightly left of the center axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large, thin-stroke header text at the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left header, moves down to the subject's face, follows the body's curve to the feet, and then moves up the right-side vertical text stack.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the subject, creating a clean, isolated 'doll-in-a-box' effect.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Brown/Black (Subject's hair and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value background with saturated jewel-tone accents against warm, rich skin tones.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to white, black, and one primary accent color

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-light geometric sans-serif and stylized brush-stroke characters
letterConstructionRules: Top header: hairline stroke weight, wide circular bowls, and extreme letter spacing
Secondary text: italicized, bold, futuristic sans-serif
Vertical text: thick outlines with soft outer glows
characterSpecificRedesigns: Wide-set 'o' and 'b' characters to emphasize horizontal span

composition.relationshipToImage: frames the head of the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast a minimalist, thin-weight English header with bold, outlined, and glowing vertical characters for a cross-cultural Y2K aesthetic.
graphicDevices: Thick black outlines on secondary text

preserve: Hairline weight of the top text
Vertical stacking of the right-side text
avoid: Centered text blocks that obscure the subject

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric circularity and thin strokes of the header.
Matches the tech-inspired secondary subtitle style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a woman with long dark hair, wearing a purple floral-patterned top and purple bottoms, in a crouching pose on a pure white background. High-key lighting, soft shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a hairline-thin geometric sans-serif title across the top in lowercase with wide tracking. Add a vertical stack of three bold, outlined characters on the right side with a soft purple outer glow.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white with no floor texture?
Is the top text thin enough to appear almost like a wireframe?
Does the purple accent in the text match the subject's clothing?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (can change from purple to blue or red)
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact character glyphs on the right

mustAchieve: Clean, high-contrast isolation of the subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the subject's feet are visible and grounded in the composition
Check that the top text does not touch the subject's hair
Verify the glow effect on the right-side text is subtle and not over-saturated
Confirm the overall layout feels airy and spacious
recipe.reuseFormula: Isolated subject + Hairline Geometric Header + Vertical Outlined Sub-text + White Void Background
